sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
The purple bar is also inert (HUD only). So far, all single clicks have been inert. Maybe the interaction is: click a ring to "select" a color, then click a corresponding colored cell on the piece to move it? Or maybe click-and-drag (but the action is MOUSE only, and maybe a sequence of MOUSEs at different positions = drag?). Or maybe the effect requires 2 clicks on the same object (a toggle).
In level 1, a single click on a ring worked. Here, a single click on a ring did nothing. Hmm, wait — maybe in level 1 the first click on the green ring also only changed the HUD, and I miscounted. Let me re-verify: in the previous turn's action list, 7 green clicks + 1 yellow click were shown, and the L change was 5→26 (7 increments). If the first green click was a no-op, then L would be 23. But I measured 26 after those 8 actions. Actually, I measured L=26 in this turn's first check (after the 8 actions). Before that, in the turn before, L was 5 (initial). So 7 green clicks → +21 → all 7 worked. OK.
So in level 1, a single click on a ring = +3 extension. In level 2, a single click on a ring = nothing. The mechanism is different.
Maybe in level 2, clicking a ring on the container makes the piece's cell of that color "pop out" / move to the container? But nothing happened.
Maybe the piece moves when you click the gray arm: the arm indicates a direction, and clicking it moves the piece in that direction by some amount. Let me try clicking the gray arm:
- Top arm (36,16)
- Left arm (37,12)
- Lower-left arm (40,9)
- Bottom arm (41,13)
Let me click the top arm (36,16).
